title: Saurios Alvedos
description: a medieval world now housing prehistoric new residents
body:
Saurios alvedos is a mod adding dinosaurs but not just dinosaurs prehistoric plants ancient civilizations and new foes and rivals
![about header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/013bbe3c4de2f2188f467afc7d6d86a43e72f8f5.png)
saurios alvedos is heavily based on it's worldbuilding and storytelling adding dinosaurs taking inspiration from fauna and cultures across the world, it's great to go with your other prehistoric mods or a standalone experience,

taking mainly inspiration from both medieval and scifi respectively, along
with alot of unique dinosaur species from tiny scavengers to giant sauropds
and a ~~special someone~~ to fight
![Content Header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3a14ba6a2f5cdd2814c3ee7ef90378b475aaec0f.png)
Saurios Alvedos's dinosaurs can be tamed and even ridden,
dinosaurs can spawn in many different biomes and enviroments

Ancient Civilization build their foundations on this
Ancient earth, from tiny tribes to sprawling empires

![things to know header thing idk](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/abcbd306a4de904f41e7a27336fd59d077c729f7.png)

this is a demo and things are expected to change
1. villages civilizations some items blocks and ~~a new boss~~ are not implemented yet
2. this is an alpha to the alpha release
3. biome variants/subspecies are also not yet implemented
4. Some Dinosaurs aren't tamable yet or not implemented
5. only 1 plant is in as of current
